steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In October 2023, Equity Mates highlighted the Birkenstock Boston as the hottest shoe on the internet and noted 72% of customers were female, pointing to strong product appeal and fashion relevance.

episode.title: Why did Birkenstocks IPO get off on the wrong foot?

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In October 2023, Equity Mates described Birkenstock as a legacy company that was profitable, positioning it as a brand making money today rather than a speculative fashion play.

episode.title: Why did Birkenstocks IPO get off on the wrong foot?

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In October 2023, Equity Mates explained Birkenstock listed in the US while L Catterton kept 83% control and 17% floated, raising US$1.4 billion and providing liquidity for investors and employees, reflecting a capital allocation focused on ownership and control.

episode.title: Why did Birkenstocks IPO get off on the wrong foot?

steps.q: Can it be bought at a reasonable price?

views.text: In October 2023, Equity Mates reported Birkenstock shares fell 13% on day one to more than 12% below the US$46 offer price, marking the worst first day for a US listing of US$1 billion or more in over two years.

episode.title: Why did Birkenstocks IPO get off on the wrong foot?
